findings.title: Make the mandatory pre-code qualification contract match the adapter inputs and observable proof.

evidence.observation: DOD-03 requires pre-code proof of the configured user/system-user token, current validity, app/scopes/granular target and exact phone membership.

The mandatory first steps require the existing compiled MetaHttpClient, allow reading only META_LOCAL_TEST_ACCESS_TOKEN in memory, and prohibit product edits/Nest bootstrap/DB before the qualification passes.
The runtime note repeats the token-only input restriction and compiled-adapter requirement.
Constructing MetaHttpClient also reads META_APP_ID, META_APP_SECRET, META_SIGNUP_CONFIG_ID and GRAPH_VERSION.
The current grant debug request needs appId|appSecret; the bootstrap token alone cannot run the existing validator.
Public exact-number methods can establish current same-app/scope/WABA authorization and phone membership. verificarNumeroVinculado uses one grant read plus at most two phone pages.

The parsed grant retains appId, is_valid, scopes and granular scopes; it neither retains/checks token type nor retains/checks explicit expiry fields. Its public exact-number result returns the number, not those metadata.

findings.analysis: The architecture can reuse this adapter without bootstrapping Nest or touching a DB, but the literal token-only read boundary is incomplete. Exact WABA/phone parameters and inherited base Meta configuration, including the existing app secret, are also inputs. Separately, a successful current adapter call proves the checks the adapter actually performs; it cannot itself substantiate a claim that token-class or explicit-expiry metadata were parsed and qualified. This is a static proof-boundary mismatch, not a claim that Meta returns an inconsistent is_valid/expiry combination and not a finding that the real token is eligible or ineligible.
findings.whyNow: Qualification is the mandatory gate before any product edit. Leaving its authorized inputs or success meaning to be improvised during the credential-bearing stage makes the frozen execution sequence non-reviewable at its first step.

recommendation.action: Before approval, name the helper's complete minimal input allowlist and delivery mechanism: the one local token, fixed expected WABA/phone, required base Meta app settings and existing app secret. Do not load or print an arbitrary dotenv/environment. Name the compiled module and source/freshness attestation, the public method sequence, bounded provider budget, safe result schema and hard-stop conditions. Define precisely whether current validity is the provider's is_valid signal. Do not claim dynamic token-class or explicit-expiry proof from the current parsed return; if those are strict additional requirements, specify a separately reviewed bounded read-only metadata check or explicit issuance-provenance evidence without relaxing any shared grant check.
minimumAcceptance: The helper can be run under the written allowlist without implicitly accessing an unapproved extra secret.
One named public exact-target method or an explicitly budgeted sequence is selected; no private-method access, OAuth exchange, Nest bootstrap or DB is needed.
The report's true booleans/enums correspond exactly to observed checks; unsupported class/expiry claims are absent or have an explicit additional evidence path.
Compiled-artifact freshness and safe failure output are reviewed before any real qualification; failure still stops before product edits.

architecture.position: Selected architecture is appropriate; qualify the pre-code contract before approval.
architecture.rationale: A separate local authorization action with immutable official-method provenance stages the existing candidate. It does not need a second channel lifecycle, generic credentials API, seed path, or global token fallback.
architecture.residual: Grant compatibility is unknown and must remain a hard pre-code stop.

correctness.position: Core behavior is specified correctly; ARCH-QUAL-01 is the material planning correction.
correctness.rationale: Method selection before reservation/idempotency, official-only nullable provenance, local JA_REGISTRADO enforcement, fixed BU/WABA/phone and existing ownership/phone/active-version checks are explicit. Local authorization must have a distinct nonce-consumption transition and safe error state, never CODE_CONSUMED or fake OAuth.
correctness.residual: No implementation exists to prove DTO propagation, local transition CAS or a migration CHECK/application invariant.

codeQuality.position: Reuse existing boundaries and factor only the repeated local policy checks.
codeQuality.rationale: The existing controller is thin and NumberRegistrationService owns the state machine. A small private configuration/policy representation can serve capabilities, authorize, options and confirm; avoid scattered process.env conditionals or duplicating the promotion transaction. No general authorization strategy framework is justified for two sources.
codeQuality.residual: Structure and error safety require review of the actual implementation.

tests.position: The proposed test-first API/PostgreSQL/adapter/browser coverage is proportionate and meaningful.
tests.rationale: The plan names wrong app/scope/granular target, replay/method changes, stale attempts, config rotation, no register, ownership/phone races, nonofficial null provenance and secret redaction. Existing PostgreSQL tests already have deterministic provider barriers for stale leases and revoked actors. Browser fixtures currently model OAuth-coded fake tokens and must represent a distinct harmless local credential without calling exchangeCode; green browser tests alone cannot prove Meta grant parsing.
tests.residual: No tests were executed; current adapter-spec contents were outside the exact supplied source set and were not assumed to pass.

performance.position: No material performance regression is inherent in the recommended path.
performance.rationale: Capabilities remain local shape/permission checks with zero provider calls. The resource is fixed, so no account-wide fan-out is needed. Existing public exact-number validation offers at most one grant read plus two phone pages; individual requests time out at 10 seconds and channel leases are 45 seconds. Retain short DB transactions and no network under locks. Pin the exact local/helper call sequence so composing existing methods does not silently duplicate grant reads beyond the inherited round budget.
performance.residual: Actual call counts, latency and query behavior are unmeasured. EPS/FRC/BCI remain pending; RLS not_needed is proportionate to the local, single-resource scope.

concurrency.position: Existing shared fences are a suitable basis; preserve them through the new entry point and config changes.
concurrency.rationale: Confirmation already acquires a channel lease, revalidates current attempt/session after provider calls, locks durable identity/BU/channel/credential and compares the active credential version before promotion. The plan explicitly extends source/target checks through candidate use and commit. Comparing the decrypted candidate token and pinned resource against the current private local configuration can be sufficient; a new global configuration service or production rotation platform is not required.
concurrency.residual: The actual before/after-network and in-transaction local config checks, stale-candidate clearing and rollback need deterministic barrier evidence. Do not consider a pre-request UI capability result an authorization fence.

security.position: Trust entry is high impact but the selected controls are sound, subject to the qualification input/proof correction.
security.rationale: The endpoint remains in the session/anti-CSRF BFF and must enforce current BU ADMIN, exact actor/session, nonce and attempt lease. Configuration grants no application permission. A target-admin capability check must receive actor context rather than reusing the current tenant-only signature without an authorization check. Tokens stay backend-only and encrypted after staging; normal send/subscribe/verify must use the channel credential. The provider debug request itself carries input_token in the provider URL, so the secret-free-URL rule must be understood and enforced for browser/log/artifact URLs rather than falsely claiming the existing adapter never puts a token in a provider-bound request.
security.residual: No private config, actual grants, runtime logs or response redaction behavior were inspected. No security implementation pass is claimed.

elegance.position: The selected path is coherent and proportionate for one explicitly enabled local resource.
elegance.rationale: One source discriminator and one guarded candidate-entry action preserve a single confirmation/promotion/consumer flow. It avoids fake OAuth, manual DB state, implicit global credentials, a separate active-token store or a parallel wizard. Shared local checks should express one policy rather than many nearly identical conditionals.
elegance.residual: A generalized authorization framework, vault, jobs/outbox or production feature-control platform would add incidental complexity outside this scope.

structuralSoundness.position: Sound target structure; no architectural bypass is required.
structuralSoundness.rationale: Attempt provenance belongs on the shared attempt model and remains null for NAO_OFICIAL. Identity ownership and active credential storage already have appropriate persistent owners. Keeping active credentials independent of the bootstrap source after promotion aligns all consumers and the receipt gate.
structuralSoundness.residual: The additive migration/backfill and method/type invariants must be tested on existing official and nonofficial rows. No schema or source was changed in this review.

operationalFit.position: Fits the stated local installation and accepted user direction; no production-support expansion is needed.
operationalFit.rationale: An independent explicit opt-in is correct even when the local process uses NODE_ENV=production. The dedicated BU should first be created through normal admin/tenant behavior, then its ID pinned in private config. Removing bootstrap settings disables new authorization; it does not revoke an already promoted credential or certify continued provider validity. Real inbound and observed outbound delivery remain independent post-implementation proofs.
operationalFit.residual: The named compiled helper module must later be available and match the source baseline without loading AppModule. Local process configuration and actual provider subscription/inbound/outbound eligibility remain unverified.
